cn-20260926-news-2.title: Bank of Japan Hikes Rates to 1.25%, a 31-Year High; ECB Hikes for the Second Time This Year: Why Major Global Central Banks Are Tightening Simultaneously

segments.src: 2026年9月，全球三家重要央行在短短九天内先后做出了同一个方向的决定：9月10日欧洲央行加息，9月16日美联储加息，9月18日日本央行加息。其中，日本央行将政策利率上调25个基点至1.25%，为1995年以来的最高水平，距今已有31年。
segments.tr: In September 2026, three major global central banks made decisions in the same direction within just nine days: the European Central Bank (ECB) hiked rates on September 10, the Federal Reserve on September 16, and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) on September 18. Notably, the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%, the highest level since 1995, marking a 31-year high.

segments.src: 三家央行几乎“同步”收紧，这在近年并不多见。本文梳理这一轮收紧的事实脉络、背后的共同背景，并对比中国当前“适度宽松”的货币政策取向，帮助读者理解为什么各国的利率走向会出现明显分化。
segments.tr: The fact that three central banks tightened policy almost "simultaneously" is rare in recent years. This article outlines the factual timeline of this tightening cycle, the shared background behind it, and compares it with China's current "moderately loose" monetary policy stance to help readers understand why interest rate trends are diverging significantly across countries.

segments.src: > 本文根据各央行公开声明及主流财经媒体的公开报道整理，数据截至2026年9月下旬，具体数值请以官方发布为准。
segments.tr: > This article is compiled based on public statements from central banks and reports from mainstream financial media. Data is current as of late September 2026; please refer to official releases for specific figures.

segments.src: ## 一、9月发生了什么：三家央行的决议一览
segments.tr: ## I. What Happened in September: An Overview of the Three Central Banks' Decisions

segments.src: | 央行 | 决议日期 | 调整幅度 | 调整后水平 | 备注 |
segments.tr: | Central Bank | Decision Date | Adjustment Magnitude | Post-Adjustment Level | Notes |

segments.src: | 欧洲央行 | 9月10日 | 上调25个基点 | 关键利率2.50% | 年内第二次加息 |
segments.tr: | ECB | September 10 | +25 basis points | Key rate 2.50% | Second hike this year |

segments.src: | 美联储 | 9月16日 | 上调25个基点 | 联邦基金利率目标区间3.75%–4.00% | 一致通过（12比0），为2023年7月以来首次加息 |
segments.tr: | Federal Reserve | September 16 | +25 basis points | Federal funds rate target range 3.75%–4.00% | Unanimous vote (12-0), first hike since July 2023 |

segments.src: | 日本央行 | 9月18日 | 上调25个基点 | 政策利率1.25% | 7比2表决通过，为1995年以来最高 |
segments.tr: | Bank of Japan | September 18 | +25 basis points | Policy rate 1.25% | Passed by 7-2 vote, highest since 1995 |

segments.src: 从幅度上看，三家央行都选择了“小步”的25个基点，而不是大幅一次性调整，显示出各方仍在谨慎权衡通胀压力与经济增长之间的关系。
segments.tr: In terms of magnitude, all three central banks chose a "small step" of 25 basis points rather than a large, one-off adjustment, indicating that all parties are still cautiously weighing the relationship between inflationary pressures and economic growth.

segments.src: ## 二、日本央行：创31年新高，但内部并非没有分歧
segments.tr: ## II. Bank of Japan: A 31-Year High, But Not Without Internal Disagreement

segments.src: 日本央行此次将政策利率从1%上调至1.25%，表决结果为7比2，有两名委员投了反对票。这说明在是否此时继续收紧的问题上，委员会内部存在不同看法。
segments.tr: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate from 1% to 1.25% with a 7-2 vote, meaning two members voted against it. This indicates that there are differing views within the committee on whether to continue tightening at this time.

segments.src: 从官方与媒体的解读来看，日本央行加息主要基于两方面考虑：
segments.tr: Based on official and media interpretations, the Bank of Japan's rate hike is primarily based on two considerations:

segments.src: 1. 物价接近目标。8月日本核心消费者物价涨幅维持在2%目标附近，能源价格上行和企业将成本向食品等商品传导，使物价压力难以迅速消退。
segments.tr: 1. Prices are nearing the target. In August, Japan's core consumer price inflation remained near the 2% target, and rising energy prices combined with companies passing costs onto goods like food make it difficult for price pressures to dissipate quickly.

segments.src: 2. 工资的结构性上升。日本央行官员曾表示，人口老龄化带来的劳动力萎缩正在推高工资，这是“不能被视为暂时性的结构性因素”。
segments.tr: 2. Structural wage increases. Bank of Japan officials have stated that the shrinking workforce due to an aging population is driving up wages, which is a "structural factor that cannot be viewed as temporary."

segments.src: 值得注意的是，市场对这次决议的反应并不一致。决议公布后，日元并未走强，美元兑日元一度升至158上方。原因在于：加息本身已被市场提前消化，而两张反对票，加上行长植田和男没有明确暗示10月会再次加息，让部分投资者认为后续收紧的节奏可能慢于预期。此后有报道称，日本央行向部分市场参与者进行了汇率询价，美元兑日元随即自158附近回落至156后半区间。
segments.tr: It is worth noting that the market's reaction to this decision was not uniform. After the decision was announced, the yen did not strengthen, and the USD/JPY exchange rate briefly rose above 158. The reason is that the rate hike itself had already been priced in by the market, and the two dissenting votes, combined with Governor Kazuo Ueda's failure to clearly signal another hike in October, led some investors to believe that the pace of subsequent tightening might be slower than expected. Reports later emerged that the Bank of Japan had conducted rate checks with some market participants, and the USD/JPY subsequently fell from around 158 to the mid-156 range.

segments.src: ## 三、共同背景：能源价格与汇率压力
segments.tr: ## III. Shared Background: Energy Prices and Exchange Rate Pressures

segments.src: 如果只看单个国家，很容易把这轮加息理解为各自的国内问题。但把三家央行放在一起，可以看到两条共同的线索。
segments.tr: If looking at a single country, it is easy to interpret this round of rate hikes as domestic issues. But by putting the three central banks together, we can see two common threads.

segments.src: 第一，能源价格推高通胀。今年以来，中东局势的不确定性抬升了能源价格，9月中旬前后国际油价一度在每桶100美元上方波动。能源是几乎所有经济体物价体系中最基础的成本项，其上涨会沿着交通、制造、食品等环节层层传导，使通胀回落变得更慢。欧洲央行的官员也指出，能源成本带来的价格压力值得警惕，同时仍在观察工资是否出现进一步的“二次传导”。
segments.tr: First, energy prices are driving up inflation. Since the beginning of the year, uncertainty in the Middle East has pushed up energy prices, with international oil prices fluctuating above $100 per barrel around mid-September. Energy is the most fundamental cost item in the price system of almost all economies, and its rise will be transmitted layer by layer through transportation, manufacturing, and food, making the decline in inflation slower. ECB officials have also pointed out that price pressures from energy costs are worth being vigilant about, while they continue to observe whether wages are showing further "second-round effects."

segments.src: 第二，汇率与利差的联动。美联储加息后，美国与日本之间的利差进一步拉大，日元面临贬值压力；而日元走弱会提高进口商品的成本，反过来又抬升日本国内通胀。对日本央行来说，加息既是应对物价，也是在一定程度上缓解汇率带来的输入性压力。
segments.tr: Second, the linkage between exchange rates and interest rate differentials. After the Federal Reserve raised rates, the interest rate differential between the U.S. and Japan widened further, putting the yen under depreciation pressure; a weaker yen increases the cost of imported goods, which in turn raises domestic inflation in Japan. For the Bank of Japan, raising rates is both a response to prices and, to some extent, a way to alleviate the imported pressure brought by the exchange rate.

segments.src: ## 四、为何会“同步”：三点观察
segments.tr: ## IV. Why "Synchronized": Three Observations

segments.src: - 面对相似的外部冲击。能源价格上涨对欧洲、美国和日本都是外生冲击，各国央行在同一时期面临类似的通胀压力。
segments.tr: - Facing similar external shocks. Rising energy prices are an exogenous shock for Europe, the U.S., and Japan, and central banks in each country are facing similar inflationary pressures during the same period.

segments.src: - 政策空间相互牵制。主要经济体的利率变化会通过汇率和资本流动相互影响。一家央行加息，其他央行若不跟进，就可能面临本币走弱、输入性通胀上升的问题。
segments.tr: - Policy space is mutually constrained. Interest rate changes in major economies affect each other through exchange rates and capital flows. If one central bank raises rates and others do not follow, they may face the problem of a weakening domestic currency and rising imported inflation.

segments.src: - 此前的宽松基调正在调整。过去几年，多数发达经济体经历了降息或维持低利率的阶段，如今随着物价数据出现反弹，政策重心重新转向控制通胀。
segments.tr: - The previous loose tone is being adjusted. Over the past few years, most developed economies experienced a phase of rate cuts or maintaining low interest rates. Now, as price data rebounds, the policy focus has shifted back to controlling inflation.

segments.src: 需要强调的是，“同步”并不意味着后续路径一致。美联储最新的预测显示，18位决策者中有16位认为年内可能再有一次加息，但此后几年并没有进一步加息的安排；日本央行的下一步则取决于物价、工资和汇率的后续数据，欧洲央行则强调将继续依据数据来决策。
segments.tr: It must be emphasized that "synchronized" does not mean that the subsequent paths will be identical. The Federal Reserve's latest forecast shows that 16 out of 18 policymakers believe there may be another rate hike within the year, but there are no further rate hike plans for the following years; the Bank of Japan's next step depends on subsequent data on prices, wages, and exchange rates, while the ECB emphasizes that it will continue to make decisions based on data.

segments.src: ## 五、中国为何不同：“适度宽松”的取向
segments.tr: ## V. Why China Is Different: A "Moderately Loose" Stance

segments.src: 在海外央行集中收紧的同时，中国的货币政策取向明显不同。
segments.tr: While overseas central banks are tightening in unison, China's monetary policy stance is clearly different.

segments.src: - 政策利率保持稳定。9月20日公布的贷款市场报价利率（LPR）中，1年期为3.0%，5年期以上为3.5%，均与上月持平，这已是连续16个月保持不变。
segments.tr: - Policy rates remain stable. In the Loan Prime Rate (LPR) announced on September 20, the 1-year rate was 3.0% and the 5-year and above rate was 3.5%, both unchanged from the previous month, marking the 16th consecutive month of stability.

segments.src: - 政策基调未变。中国人民银行货币政策委员会在2026年第三季度例会（9月19日）上提出，要继续实施适度宽松的货币政策，加大逆周期调节力度。
segments.tr: - Policy tone remains unchanged. The Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China proposed at its third-quarter meeting in 2026 (September 19) to continue implementing a moderately loose monetary policy and to increase counter-cyclical adjustments.

segments.src: 多位分析人士认为，海外央行加息对中国货币政策的影响有限，主要原因有两点：
segments.tr: Many analysts believe that the impact of overseas central bank rate hikes on China's monetary policy is limited, mainly for two reasons:

segments.src: 1. 国内外物价走势存在根本差异。决定货币政策方向的核心是本国的物价与增长状况，海外面临的能源型通胀压力，与国内的价格环境并不相同，因此政策方向出现差异是合理的。
segments.tr: 1. Fundamental differences in domestic and international price trends. The core of determining the direction of monetary policy is the country's own price and growth situation. The energy-driven inflationary pressure faced overseas is not the same as the domestic price environment, so it is reasonable for policy directions to diverge.

segments.src: 2. 跨境资金流动管理框架较为完善。中国已建立起“宏观审慎+微观监管”的跨境资金流动管理框架，有助于缓冲外部金融环境变化带来的冲击。
segments.tr: 2. The cross-border capital flow management framework is relatively sound. China has established a "macro-prudential + micro-supervision" cross-border capital flow management framework, which helps buffer the shocks brought by changes in the external financial environment.

segments.src: 同时，相关分析也提到，近期国内CPI和PPI同比增速有所回暖，人民币汇率总体保持稳中有升，外部利率上行并未对其形成明显压力。
segments.tr: At the same time, relevant analyses also mentioned that recent domestic CPI and PPI year-on-year growth rates have warmed up, the RMB exchange rate has generally remained stable with an upward trend, and the rise in external interest rates has not exerted significant pressure on it.

segments.src: ## 六、这对普通人意味着什么
segments.tr: ## VI. What This Means for Ordinary People

segments.src: 以下内容仅为一般性的知识介绍，不构成任何投资或消费建议：
segments.tr: The following content is for general knowledge introduction only and does not constitute any investment or consumption advice:

segments.src: - 汇率方面：主要货币的利差变化，会影响日元、欧元、美元等币种的走势。有出境旅行、留学或跨境支付安排的读者，可以留意汇率的阶段性波动，并结合自身需求合理规划。
segments.tr: - Exchange rates: Changes in interest rate differentials of major currencies will affect the trends of currencies such as the yen, euro, and U.S. dollar. Readers with plans for outbound travel, studying abroad, or cross-border payments can pay attention to the periodic fluctuations in exchange rates and plan reasonably according to their own needs.

segments.src: - 利率环境方面：海外利率上行会提高外币融资成本，也会影响全球金融市场的风险偏好。国内利率则更多取决于国内经济与物价形势。
segments.tr: - Interest rate environment: Rising overseas interest rates will increase the cost of foreign currency financing and will also affect the risk appetite of global financial markets. Domestic interest rates depend more on the domestic economic and price situation.

segments.src: - 信息判断方面：央行政策受多重因素影响，单一事件难以直接推断长期走势，建议以官方数据和权威渠道的信息为准。
segments.tr: - Information judgment: Central bank policies are influenced by multiple factors, and it is difficult to directly infer long-term trends from a single event. It is recommended to rely on official data and information from authoritative channels.

segments.src: ## 七、后续值得关注的几个节点
segments.tr: ## VII. Several Nodes Worth Watching in the Future

segments.src: 1. 日本央行的下一次会议：关注植田和男对后续加息节奏的表态，以及工资和核心物价数据。
segments.tr: 1. The Bank of Japan's next meeting: Pay attention to Kazuo Ueda's stance on the pace of subsequent rate hikes, as well as wage and core price data.

segments.src: 2. 美联储年内的后续决议：关注是否如最新预测所示再度上调利率。
segments.tr: 2. The Federal Reserve's subsequent decisions within the year: Pay attention to whether interest rates will be raised again as indicated in the latest forecast.

segments.src: 3. 能源价格与中东局势：这是本轮收紧的共同背景，其走向将直接影响各国通胀预期。
segments.tr: 3. Energy prices and the Middle East situation: This is the common background for this round of tightening, and its trend will directly affect inflation expectations in various countries.

segments.src: 4. 中国的物价与政策信号：关注CPI、PPI的持续性，以及货币政策委员会后续的表述变化。
segments.tr: 4. China's price and policy signals: Pay attention to the sustainability of CPI and PPI, as well as subsequent changes in the statements of the Monetary Policy Committee.

segments.src: ## 结语
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: 日本央行创31年新高的加息，与欧洲央行、美联储的同期动作叠加，构成了2026年秋季全球货币环境的一个重要转折。它们的共同点是应对能源价格与汇率带来的通胀压力，而不同点在于各自经济的物价、增长与政策空间。在这样的背景下，中国维持“适度宽松”的取向，恰恰体现了不同经济体“因国施策”的逻辑。
segments.tr: The Bank of Japan's rate hike to a 31-year high, superimposed with the concurrent actions of the ECB and the Federal Reserve, constitutes an important turning point in the global monetary environment in the autumn of 2026. Their commonality is responding to inflationary pressures brought about by energy prices and exchange rates, while the differences lie in their respective economic prices, growth, and policy space. Against this background, China's maintenance of a "moderately loose" stance precisely reflects the logic of different economies "implementing policies according to their own national conditions."

segments.src: *免责声明：本文仅供信息参考与知识分享之用，不构成任何投资、理财或其他专业建议。文中涉及的数据和观点来自公开信息，可能随时间变化，读者在做出决策前请自行核实并咨询专业人士。*

The data and views involved in the article come from public information and may change over time. Readers should verify and consult professionals before making decisions.*

cn-20260926-news-3.title: Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day "Double Festival" Travel Expected to Reach 2.78 Billion Passenger-Trips: Railways Send 284 Million Passenger-Trips in 16 Days, October 1 Welcomes Peak Passenger Flow, How Capacity Ensures Support

segments.src: 中秋与国庆相邻，今年的“双节”假期再次迎来出行高峰。根据相关部门发布的预测数据，中秋假期跨区域人员流动量预计约6.5亿人次，国庆7天假期预计约21.3亿人次，两者合计约27.8亿人次。面对如此庞大的出行需求，铁路、公路、民航如何分工协作、保障运力？本文结合公开的预测信息，做一次梳理。
segments.tr: With the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day adjacent to each other, this year's "Double Festival" holiday is once again ushering in a travel peak. According to forecast data released by relevant departments, the inter-regional flow of people during the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday is expected to be about 650 million passenger-trips, and the 7-day National Day holiday is expected to be about 2.13 billion passenger-trips, totaling about 2.78 billion passenger-trips. Facing such huge travel demand, how do railways, highways, and civil aviation division of labor and cooperation to guarantee transport capacity? This article combines publicly available forecast information to make a summary.

segments.src: ## 一、一组数字看懂“双节”出行规模
segments.tr: ## I. Understand the Scale of "Double Festival" Travel Through a Set of Numbers

segments.src: 需要说明的是，以上均为预测或计划性数据，实际客流会受天气、临时安排、突发情况等因素影响，最终数据以官方后续发布为准。
segments.tr: It should be noted that the above are all forecast or planned data. Actual passenger flow will be affected by weather, temporary arrangements, emergencies, and other factors. Final data shall be subject to subsequent official releases.

segments.src: ## 二、为什么客流会集中在10月1日前后
segments.tr: ## II. Why Passenger Flow Concentrates Around October 1

segments.src: “双节”叠加的出行有几个鲜明特点：
segments.tr: The overlapping "Double Festival" travel has several distinct characteristics:

segments.src: 1. **出行目的多元。** 返乡团圆、探亲访友、旅游度假、短途自驾等需求同时释放，客流结构比平日更加复杂。
segments.tr: 1. **Diverse travel purposes.** Returning home for family reunions, visiting relatives and friends, tourism and vacation, short-distance self-driving and other demands are released simultaneously, making the passenger flow structure more complex than usual.

segments.src: 2. **时间点相对集中。** 国庆假期首日通常是长假出发的“第一波高峰”，今年铁路客流预计在10月1日达到最高峰；假期后段则会迎来返程高峰，前后形成两个明显的波峰。
segments.tr: 2. **Relatively concentrated time points.** The first day of the National Day holiday is usually the "first wave of peak" for long-term departures. This year's railway passenger flow is expected to reach its peak on October 1; the latter part of the holiday will usher in a return peak, forming two distinct peaks before and after.

segments.src: 3. **周期拉长。** 铁路运输从9月23日持续到10月8日，覆盖中秋前后、国庆前后共16天，意味着运输组织要打“持久战”，而不只是应对某一天的冲击。
segments.tr: 3. **Extended cycle.** Railway transportation lasts from September 23 to October 8, covering a total of 16 days before and after the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day, meaning that transportation organization must fight a "protracted war" rather than just coping with the impact of a single day.

segments.src: 按国庆7天预计21.3亿人次计算，日均约3亿人次。这一规模，既考验各类交通方式的运输能力，也考验运输组织、信息发布和现场服务的精细程度。
segments.tr: Calculated on the basis of 2.13 billion passenger-trips expected for the 7-day National Day, the daily average is about 300 million passenger-trips. This scale tests not only the transportation capacity of various transportation modes, but also the refinement level of transportation organization, information release, and on-site service.

segments.src: ## 三、铁路：加开列车，为高峰“托底”
segments.tr: ## III. Railway: Additional Trains to "Support" the Peak

segments.src: 铁路是“双节”出行的主力之一。按照预测，9月23日至10月8日的16天运输期内，铁路预计发送旅客约2.84亿人次，折算下来日均约1775万人次。
segments.tr: Railways are one of the mainstays of "Double Festival" travel. According to forecasts, during the 16-day transportation period from September 23 to October 8, railways are expected to send about 284 million passengers, translating to an average of about 17.75 million passengers per day.

segments.src: 在运力安排上，主要有几个看点：
segments.tr: In terms of transport capacity arrangement, there are several main highlights:

segments.src: - **日均开行约1.3万列。** 这是基础运力盘子，保证了主要干线和城际线路的班次密度。
segments.tr: - **Average daily operation of about 13,000 trains.** This is the basic capacity plate, ensuring the frequency density of main trunk lines and intercity lines.

segments.src: - **单日最多增开890列。** 在客流预计最集中的日子里，通过增开临客、加开热门方向列车等方式，提高供给能力，缓解热门线路、热门时段一票难求的压力。
segments.tr: - **Maximum single-day addition of 890 trains.** On days when passenger traffic is expected to be most concentrated, supply capacity is improved by adding temporary trains and trains in popular directions, alleviating the pressure of hard-to-get tickets on popular lines and during popular periods.

segments.src: - **日均客运量预计增长约1.4%。** 增幅看似不高，但在已经很大的基数上继续增长，对运输组织的要求并不低。
segments.tr: - **Average daily passenger traffic is expected to grow by about 1.4%.** The growth rate may seem low, but continuing to grow on an already large base places high demands on transport organization.

segments.src: 从实际运营角度看，“托底”不仅是多开列车，还包括更细致的工作：根据预售情况动态调整运力，重点保障热门方向和中转枢纽，加强车站的客流疏导、安检和候车秩序管理，以及做好设备巡检和应急处置准备。
segments.tr: From the perspective of actual operation, "supporting the bottom" is not only running more trains, but also includes more meticulous work: dynamically adjusting transport capacity based on pre-sale conditions, focusing on guaranteeing popular directions and transfer hubs, strengthening passenger flow diversion, security checks and waiting order management at stations, as well as making preparations for equipment inspection and emergency response.

segments.src: ## 四、公路：7座及以下小客车高速免费通行
segments.tr: ## IV. Highway: Free Passage on Expressways for Small Passenger Cars with 7 Seats and Below

segments.src: 公路方面，自驾依然是“双节”出行的重要方式。国庆期间，7座及以下小客车在高速公路上享受免费通行政策，这对自驾游、返乡和短途出行的家庭来说是一项实实在在的便利。
segments.tr: In terms of highways, self-driving remains an important way of traveling during the "Double Festival". During the National Day, small passenger cars with 7 seats and below enjoy free passage on expressways, which is a tangible convenience for families traveling by car, returning home, and taking short trips.

segments.src: 不过，免费通行也意味着高速公路车流可能在特定时段明显增加，容易出现局部拥堵、服务区排队、车速缓慢等情况。出行前建议留意：
segments.tr: However, free passage also means that highway traffic may increase significantly during specific periods, and local congestion, service area queues, slow driving speeds and other situations are prone to occur. It is recommended to pay attention before traveling:

segments.src: - **具体的免费通行起止时间、适用车型和例外情形，以交通运输部门的正式公告为准。**
segments.tr: - **The specific start and end times of free passage, applicable vehicle types, and exception circumstances shall be subject to official announcements by transport departments.**

segments.src: - 提前通过导航软件或官方渠道查看实时路况，避开出发首日上午、返程日下午等高峰时段。
segments.tr: - Check real-time road conditions in advance through navigation software or official channels, and avoid peak periods such as the morning of the departure day and the afternoon of the return trip.

segments.src: - 长途驾驶注意劳逸结合，避免疲劳驾驶，合理规划休息和加油、充电的时间。
segments.tr: - Pay attention to combining work and rest during long-distance driving, avoid fatigue driving, and reasonably plan the time for rest, refueling, and charging.

segments.src: ## 五、民航：小幅增长，稳中有进
segments.tr: ## V. Civil Aviation: Moderate Growth, Stable Progress

segments.src: 民航方面，日均客运量预计增长约0.6%，增幅相对温和。与铁路相比，民航更适合中长距离出行，“双节”期间的热门航线、热门时段仍可能较为紧张。旅客出行时可以：
segments.tr: In terms of civil aviation, the average daily passenger traffic is expected to grow by about 0.6%, with a relatively moderate increase. Compared with railways, civil aviation is more suitable for medium and long-distance travel. Popular routes and popular periods during the "Double Festival" may still be relatively tight. Passengers can do the following when traveling:

segments.src: - 提前关注航班动态，预留充足的到达机场和安检时间；
segments.tr: - Pay attention to flight dynamics in advance and reserve sufficient arrival airport and security check time;

segments.src: - 涉及中转的行程，适当预留衔接时间，以免因延误影响后续行程；
segments.tr: - For itineraries involving transfers, appropriately reserve connection time to avoid delays affecting subsequent trips;

segments.src: - 通过航空公司官方渠道购票和办理变更，注意查看退改签规则。
segments.tr: - Purchase tickets and process changes through official channels of airlines, and pay attention to refund and change rules.

segments.src: ## 六、出行小贴士：让“双节”之旅更顺畅
segments.tr: ## VI. Travel Tips: Making Your "Double Festival" Journey Smoother

segments.src: 1. **错峰出行。** 能够灵活安排时间的旅客，可以考虑避开10月1日前后及返程集中日，选择客流相对平缓的时段。
segments.tr: 1. **Off-peak travel.** Travelers who can flexibly arrange their time can consider avoiding the days around October 1 and the concentrated return days, and choose periods with relatively smooth passenger flow.

segments.src: 2. **通过官方渠道购票。** 购买铁路车票请使用官方平台，谨防以“加价抢票”“内部渠道”等名义实施的诈骗，也不要向陌生人透露个人证件信息和验证码。
segments.tr: 2. **Purchase tickets through official channels.** Please use official platforms to purchase train tickets, beware of fraud committed under the names of "markup ticket grabbing" or "internal channels", and do not disclose personal ID information and verification codes to strangers.

segments.src: 3. **携带好证件和必需品。** 乘车、乘机需要有效证件；带老人、儿童同行的，可提前备好常用药品和随身物品。
segments.tr: 3. **Carry valid documents and essentials.** Valid documents are required for taking trains and flights; those traveling with the elderly and children can prepare commonly used medicines and personal belongings in advance.

segments.src: 4. **关注官方通知。** 天气变化、线路调整、临时停运等信息，请及时通过铁路、航空、交通部门的官方渠道核实。
segments.tr: 4. **Pay attention to official notices.** For information such as weather changes, route adjustments, and temporary suspensions, please verify through official channels of railway, aviation, and transportation departments in a timely manner.

segments.src: 5. **文明出行、注意安全。** 遵守站车秩序和交通规则，遇到问题及时向工作人员求助。
segments.tr: 5. **Travel civilized and pay attention to safety.** Observe station and train order and traffic rules, and seek help from staff in time when encountering problems.

segments.src: ## 七、结语
segments.tr: ## VII. Conclusion

segments.src: “双节”出行预计达到27.8亿人次，反映的是节日期间人们团聚、出游的旺盛需求，也是对综合交通运输体系的一次集中检验。铁路日均开行约1.3万列、单日最多增开890列，公路对7座及以下小客车实行高速免费通行，民航与铁路日均客运量预计分别增长约0.6%和1.4%，多种交通方式各展所长，共同为高峰期出行提供支撑。
segments.tr: The "Double Festival" travel is expected to reach 2.78 billion passenger-trips, reflecting the strong demand of people for gathering and traveling during the holiday, and it is also a concentrated test of the comprehensive transportation system. Railways operate an average of about 13,000 trains daily with a maximum single-day addition of 890 trains, highways implement free expressway passage for small passenger cars of 7 seats and below, and civil aviation and railway average daily passenger traffic are expected to grow by about 0.6% and 1.4% respectively. Various transportation methods display their strengths and jointly provide support for peak travel.

segments.src: 对于普通旅客而言，提前规划、错峰出行、通过官方渠道获取信息，是让旅途更从容的关键。祝各位读者“双节”出行平安顺利，度过一个温馨愉快的假期。
segments.tr: For ordinary passengers, early planning, off-peak travel, and obtaining information through official channels are the keys to making the journey more calm. I wish all readers a safe and smooth "Double Festival" travel and a warm and pleasant holiday.

cn-20260926-intro-retail-8.title: [Retail Studies #8] With Only Three Meters of Shelf Space, What Do You Sell, How Much Do You Sell, and Who Do You Buy From?

segments.src: > 商品企划(Merchandising),说白了就是用有限的货架和有限的现金,回答三个问题:卖什么(商品组合)、卖多少(商品计划)、从谁那儿进(采购)。
segments.tr: > Merchandising, simply put, uses limited shelf space and limited cash to answer three questions: what to sell (product assortment), how much to sell (merchandise planning), and who to buy from (purchasing).

segments.src: ## 今日概念
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: 零售商最稀缺的资源有两样:**货架**和**现金**。开一家 60 平米的社区便利店,货架撑死放两千来个 SKU;账上能压在库存里的钱,可能就三十几万元。全世界有几千万种商品,你只能选进来两千种——这个"选"的过程,就是商品企划。
segments.tr: Retailers have two scarcest resources: **shelves** and **cash**. When opening a 60-square-meter community convenience store, the shelves can at most hold around 2,000 SKUs; the money tied up in inventory on the books might be around 300,000 yuan. There are tens of millions of products in the world, and you can only choose 2,000 of them—this "selection" process is merchandising.

segments.src: 它由三块拼成:
segments.tr: It is made up of three parts:

segments.src: **一、商品组合(卖什么)**
segments.tr: **1. Product Assortment (What to Sell)**

segments.src: 组合有两个维度,记住这一对就够了:
segments.tr: Assortment has two dimensions, and remembering this pair is enough:

segments.src: - **宽度**:你卖多少个品类。只卖饮料是窄,饮料+鲜食+日用品+文具是宽。
segments.tr: - **Width**: How many categories you sell. Selling only beverages is narrow; beverages + fresh food + daily necessities + stationery is wide.

segments.src: - **深度**:每个品类里卖多少个品种。矿泉水只放农夫山泉一款是浅,农夫山泉、怡宝、百岁山、依云都放是深。
segments.tr: - **Depth**: How many varieties you sell within each category. Having only Nongfu Spring mineral water is shallow; having Nongfu Spring, Yibao, Baisuishan, and Evian is deep.

segments.src: 宽度和深度是跷跷板:货架长度固定,加宽就得变浅。名创优品走的是"宽而浅",一个品类几款爆品;山姆走的是"极窄极深的自有品牌"——SKU 只有四千左右,但每一款都做到极致。
segments.tr: Width and depth are a seesaw: shelf length is fixed, so widening means getting shallower. Miniso goes for "wide and shallow", with a few hit products per category; Sam's Club goes for "extremely narrow and deep private brands"—with only about 4,000 SKUs, but making every single one to the extreme.

segments.src: 商品组合里还要分角色:
segments.tr: Roles also need to be assigned within the product assortment:

segments.src: - **引流品**:顾客对价格特别敏感、闭着眼都知道多少钱的商品(2 元的矿泉水、鸡蛋、大米)。毛利低,但没有它顾客不进门。
segments.tr: - **Traffic-driving products**: Products to which customers are extremely price-sensitive and know the price of blindly (2-yuan mineral water, eggs, rice). Low gross margin, but without them, customers won't step through the door.

segments.src: - **利润品**:顾客说不清合理价的商品(现磨咖啡、关东煮、烘焙)。毛利率能到 50% 以上。
segments.tr: - **Profit-making products**: Products for which customers cannot clearly state a reasonable price (freshly ground coffee, oden, bakery). Gross margin can reach over 50%.

segments.src: - **形象品/季节品**:撑门面和跟节气的,比如中秋的月饼礼盒。
segments.tr: - **Image/seasonal products**: For show and keeping up with solar terms, such as Mid-Autumn Festival mooncake gift boxes.

segments.src: **二、商品计划(卖多少)**
segments.tr: **2. Merchandise Planning (How Much to Sell)**

segments.src: 选好卖什么,接下来是"每样进多少钱的货"。核心不是拍脑袋,而是一条库存等式:
segments.tr: After choosing what to sell, the next step is "how much money's worth of goods to stock for each." The core is not guessing, but an inventory equation:

segments.src: 期初库存 + 本期进货 − 本期销售 = 期末库存
segments.tr: 期初库存 + 本期进货 − 本期销售 = 期末库存

segments.src: 把这条式子倒过来解,就得到零售业最实用的工具——**OTB(可采购额 / Open-to-Buy)**:
segments.tr: Solving this equation backward gives the most practical tool in the retail industry—**OTB (Open-to-Buy)**:

segments.src: 可采购额 = 计划销售额 + 计划期末库存 − 期初库存 − 已下单未到货
segments.tr: 可采购额 = 计划销售额 + 计划期末库存 − 期初库存 − 已下单未到货

segments.src: 它是采购的"额度上限"。超额进货 = 现金变成滞销库存;不足 = 缺货、顾客流失。
segments.tr: It is the "spending limit" for purchasing. Over-purchasing = cash turns into unsellable inventory; insufficient = out of stock, customer loss.

segments.src: **三、采购/买手(从谁那儿进)**
segments.tr: **3. Purchasing/Buyer (Who to Buy From)**

segments.src: 买手不只是"砍价的人"。他要定进价、定售价、谈账期和返点、决定是进品牌货还是做自有品牌。两个基础算式别搞混:
segments.tr: A buyer is not just a "bargainer." They must set purchase prices, set retail prices, negotiate payment terms and rebates, and decide whether to buy branded goods or make private labels. Don't confuse two basic formulas:

segments.src: 毛利率 = (售价 − 进价) ÷ 售价
segments.tr: 毛利率 = (售价 − 进价) ÷ 售价

segments.src: 加价率 = (售价 − 进价) ÷ 进价
segments.tr: 加价率 = (售价 − 进价) ÷ 进价

segments.src: 进价 6 元、卖 10 元:毛利率 40%,加价率约 67%。同一件事,分母不同,数字差很远。
segments.tr: Purchase price 6 yuan, sell for 10 yuan: gross margin 40%, markup rate about 67%. For the same thing, with different denominators, the numbers are very far apart.

segments.src: 而判断"这个商品值不值得占货架",光看毛利率不够,还要看周转:
segments.tr: To judge "whether this product is worth taking up shelf space," looking at the gross margin alone is not enough; you also have to look at turnover:

segments.src: GMROI = 毛利额 ÷ 平均库存(按成本价计)
segments.tr: GMROI = 毛利额 ÷ 平均库存(按成本价计)

segments.src: 一款毛利率 50% 但半年卖不动的红酒,和一款毛利率 15% 但一周转一次的酸奶,后者往往更赚钱。**毛利率高不等于赚钱,毛利率 × 周转速度才等于赚钱。**
segments.tr: A red wine with a 50% gross margin that hasn't sold in half a year, and a yogurt with a 15% gross margin that turns over once a week—the latter is often more profitable. **High gross margin does not equal making money; gross margin × turnover speed equals making money.**

segments.src: ## 生活中的场景
segments.tr: ## Real-Life Scenarios

segments.src: 杭州某小区门口的一家便利店,老板娘一个人同时干着商品企划和买手的活。
segments.tr: At a convenience store at the entrance of a residential compound in Hangzhou, the female boss handles both merchandising and buying by herself.

segments.src: 11 月初,她盘了一下账:
segments.tr: In early November, she checked her accounts:

segments.src: - 货架和仓库里现有库存(按零售价算)28 万元
segments.tr: - Existing inventory on shelves and in the warehouse (calculated at retail price) 280,000 yuan

segments.src: - 上月已经下单、还没到货的 3 万元
segments.tr: - Ordered last month, not yet arrived 30,000 yuan

segments.src: - 参考去年同期 + 今年小区新入住率,预计 11 月能卖 30 万元
segments.tr: - Referring to the same period last year + the community's new occupancy rate this year, expected November sales 300,000 yuan

segments.src: - 12 月要备元旦,月底希望手上留 25 万元库存
segments.tr: - Preparing for New Year's Day in December, hoping to keep 250,000 yuan of inventory on hand at the end of the month

segments.src: 套进 OTB:
segments.tr: Plugged into OTB:

segments.src: 这个月她最多只能再进 24 万元的货。于是这 24 万怎么分?
segments.tr: This month she can buy at most another 240,000 yuan worth of goods. So how to divide this 240k?

segments.src: - 农夫山泉 550ml 卖 2 元,毛利率不到 20%,但它是**引流品**——不能断货,必须占额度;
segments.tr: - Nongfu Spring 550ml sells for 2 yuan, gross margin is less than 20%, but it's a **traffic-driving product**—cannot be out of stock, must occupy the budget;

segments.src: - 天冷了,冰柜的位置让一半给**关东煮和热饮**(季节性调整深度),冰淇淋从 12 个口味缩到 4 个;
segments.tr: - When it gets cold, give half of the refrigerator space to **oden and hot drinks** (seasonal depth adjustment), and reduce ice cream from 12 flavors to 4;

segments.src: - 现磨咖啡毛利率 60%,是**利润品**,值得多花 3 万元升级机器和物料;
segments.tr: - Freshly ground coffee gross margin is 60%, it's a **profit-making product**, worth spending an extra 30,000 yuan to upgrade machines and materials;

segments.src: - 去年压了两个月才卖完的进口零食,今年直接砍掉——它的 GMROI 太低,占着货架不产钱。
segments.tr: - Imported snacks that sat for two months before selling out last year are directly cut this year—their GMROI is too low, taking up shelf space without generating cash.

segments.src: 同样是 24 万元,分法不同,月底的利润能差出好几万。这就是商品企划的价值:它不是"进货",是**给每一分现金和每一厘米货架排座位**。
segments.tr: Even with 240,000 yuan, different allocation methods can make the end-of-month profit differ by tens of thousands. This is the value of merchandising: it is not "purchasing goods," it is **assigning seats to every single cent of cash and every single centimeter of shelf space**.

segments.src: ## 三句话总结
segments.tr: ## Summary in Three Sentences

segments.src: 1. 商品组合决定"卖什么":宽度(品类数)和深度(每品类的品种数)是一对跷跷板,还要分清引流品和利润品。
segments.tr: 1. Product assortment determines "what to sell": width (number of categories) and depth (number of varieties per category) are a seesaw, and traffic drivers and profit makers must be distinguished.

segments.src: 2. 商品计划决定"卖多少":用 OTB(计划销售 + 计划期末库存 − 期初库存 − 在途)算出采购额度,现金不越界。
segments.tr: 2. Merchandise planning determines "how much to sell": use OTB (planned sales + planned ending inventory − beginning inventory − in-transit) to calculate the purchasing budget, keeping cash within bounds.

segments.src: 3. 采购决定"从谁那儿进、卖多少钱":毛利率和加价率的分母不同别搞混,判断一个商品的真实贡献要看 GMROI,即毛利与周转的合力。
segments.tr: 3. Purchasing determines "who to buy from and how much to sell for": don't confuse the denominators of gross margin and markup rate; judging a product's true contribution requires looking at GMROI, which is the combined force of gross profit and turnover speed.

segments.src: ## ✅ 自测小测验
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Test Quiz

segments.src: **Q1.** 一家原本只卖饮料和零食的便利店,新增了"现磨咖啡"这个品类。这属于扩大商品组合的哪一项?
segments.tr: **Q1.** A convenience store that originally only sold beverages and snacks added a "freshly ground coffee" category. Which aspect of expanding the product assortment does this belong to?

segments.src: A.
segments.tr: A.

segments.src: 宽度 　B.
segments.tr: Width 　B.

segments.tr: Depth 　C.

## 📚 今日术语
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terminology

segments.src: - **商品组合(Assortment)**:一家店实际经营的全部商品集合,主要用宽度(品类数)和深度(每个品类的品种数)来描述。
segments.tr: - **Assortment**: The collection of all products actually operated by a store, mainly described by width (number of categories) and depth (number of varieties per category).

segments.src: - **SKU(库存量单位)**:能被单独管理和盘点的最小商品单位;同款不同容量、不同口味算作不同 SKU。
segments.tr: - **SKU (Stock Keeping Unit)**: The smallest unit of merchandise that can be independently managed and inventoried; the same style with different capacities or flavors counts as different SKUs.

segments.src: - **OTB(可采购额)**:在不打乱库存和现金计划的前提下,本期还能采购的金额上限。
segments.tr: - **OTB (Open-to-Buy)**: The upper limit of the amount that can still be purchased in the current period without disrupting inventory and cash plans.

segments.src: - **引流品(KVI)**:顾客对价格高度敏感、用来判断"这家店贵不贵"的商品,通常低毛利经营。
segments.tr: - **KVI (Key Value Indicator / Traffic-driving product)**: Products to which customers are highly price-sensitive and used to judge "whether this store is expensive," usually operated with low gross margins.

segments.src: - **GMROI(毛利投资回报率)**:毛利额 ÷ 平均库存成本,衡量"压在库存上的每一元钱赚回多少毛利",把毛利率和周转速度合成一个指标。
segments.tr: - **GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment)**: Gross profit ÷ average inventory cost, measuring "how much gross profit is earned back for every yuan tied up in inventory," combining gross margin and turnover speed into one metric.

segments.src: *答案:Q1 → A。新增一个从未经营过的品类,增加的是组合的宽度;如果是在咖啡里从 1 款加到 5 款,那才是深度。
segments.tr: *Answers: Q1 → A. Adding a category never operated before increases the width of the assortment; going from 1 to 5 varieties within coffee is depth.

segments.src: Q2 → X。引流品的作用是把顾客带进门,它的价值不在自身毛利,而在带动利润品(咖啡、鲜食)的连带销售;砍掉引流品往往会让客流和总利润一起下滑。
segments.tr: Q2 → X. The role of traffic-driving products is to bring customers through the door; their value lies not in their own gross margin, but in driving the joint sales of profit-making products (coffee, fresh food); cutting traffic drivers often leads to a decline in foot traffic and total profits together.

segments.src: Q3 → A。30 + 25 − 28 − 3 = 24 万元。注意"已下单未到货"必须扣除,否则会重复采购、造成库存积压。*
segments.tr: Q3 → A. 30 + 25 − 28 − 3 = 240,000 yuan. Note that "ordered but unreceived" must be deducted, otherwise it will cause duplicate purchasing and inventory backlog.*

cn-20260926-news-1.title: What signals does the central bank's Q3 regular meeting send: emphasizing increased counter-cyclical adjustment, adding the "six networks" support direction, and no longer mentioning "opportunely lowering reserve requirement ratios and interest rates"

segments.src: 9月24日，中国人民银行货币政策委员会召开2026年三季度例会。与以往相比，这份例会通稿在几处措辞上出现了变化，也引发了市场对四季度货币政策空间的讨论。本文梳理通稿中值得关注的三点变化，并对相关解读做一个客观的整理。
segments.tr: On September 24, the Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China held its regular meeting for the third quarter of 2026. Compared with the past, this meeting press release has changed in several expressions, which has also triggered market discussions on the room for monetary policy in the fourth quarter. This article sorts out three changes worth noting in the press release and provides an objective arrangement of related interpretations.

segments.src: > 说明：本文基于公开信息整理，仅供阅读参考，不构成任何投资或决策建议。具体表述请以中国人民银行官方发布的文件为准。
segments.tr: > Note: This article is compiled based on public information for reading and reference only, and does not constitute any investment or decision-making advice. For specific expressions, please refer to the official documents released by the People's Bank of China.

segments.src: ## 一、三处措辞变化
segments.tr: ## I. Three Changes in Wording

segments.src: ### 1. 基调：继续强调“适度宽松”
segments.tr: ### 1. Tone: Continue to emphasize "moderately loose"

segments.src: 例会重申了“适度宽松”的货币政策取向。这意味着总体基调没有改变，货币政策仍以支持经济回升向好、保持金融市场稳定运行为主要方向。
segments.tr: The regular meeting reaffirmed the "moderately loose" monetary policy orientation. This means that the overall tone has not changed, and monetary policy still takes supporting economic recovery and maintaining the stable operation of the financial market as its main direction.

segments.src: ### 2. 调节方式：从“逆周期和跨周期调节”到“逆周期调节”
segments.tr: ### 2. Adjustment method: From "counter-cyclical and cross-cyclical adjustment" to "counter-cyclical adjustment"

segments.src: 通稿将此前的“逆周期和跨周期调节”调整为“逆周期调节”，并提出要加大调节力度。
segments.tr: The press release adjusted the previous "counter-cyclical and cross-cyclical adjustment" to "counter-cyclical adjustment", and proposed to increase the intensity of adjustment.

segments.src: 从字面看，“跨周期”强调的是着眼较长时间维度、平滑经济运行的中长期波动；“逆周期”则更强调针对当前经济运行中的阶段性变化进行及时对冲。表述的调整，可以理解为政策在关注短期经济运行方面的权重有所上升。不过，单凭措辞变化并不能断定具体政策工具的出台时点和规模，仍需结合后续的操作与数据来观察。
segments.tr: Literally, "cross-cyclical" emphasizes focusing on a longer time dimension and smoothing the medium- and long-term fluctuations of economic operation; "counter-cyclical" emphasizes timely hedging against phased changes in current economic operation. The adjustment of the expression can be understood as an increase in the weight of policies focusing on short-term economic operations. However, the wording change alone cannot determine the timing and scale of specific policy tools, and it still needs to be observed in combination with subsequent operations and data.

segments.src: ### 3. 重点领域：首次列入“六张网”建设
segments.tr: ### 3. Key areas: Included in the construction of "six networks" for the first time

segments.src: 例会首次把“六张网”建设列为重点支持领域。“六张网”属于网络型基础设施建设方面的表述，涉及的具体领域和范围，以官方文件为准。
segments.tr: The regular meeting listed the construction of the "six networks" as a key support area for the first time. The "six networks" belong to the expression of network-type infrastructure construction, and the specific areas and scopes involved are subject to official documents.

segments.src: 这一新增内容说明，金融支持的方向更加突出对重大项目和基础设施建设的服务。从政策工具的角度看，结构性货币政策工具、信贷资源配置和融资服务等，都可能成为支持这类领域的渠道，但具体安排仍有待央行及相关部门进一步说明。
segments.tr: This new content shows that the direction of financial support highlights the service for major projects and infrastructure construction. From the perspective of policy tools, structural monetary policy tools, credit resource allocation, and financing services may all become channels to support such areas, but specific arrangements still need to be further explained by the central bank and relevant departments.

segments.src: ## 二、为什么“没有提降准降息”受到关注
segments.tr: ## II. Why "not mentioning lowering reserve requirement ratios and interest rates" has attracted attention

segments.src: 此前的一些例会通稿中曾出现“择机降准降息”的表述，而这次的通稿里没有再出现这一提法。由此，市场出现了不同的解读：
segments.tr: Some previous regular meeting press releases contained the expression "opportunely lowering reserve requirement ratios and interest rates", but this press release no longer appeared. As a result, different interpretations have emerged in the market:

segments.src: - **观点一：总量工具的节奏可能更加审慎。** 有分析认为，不再提及这一表述，可能意味着短期内是否使用降准降息等总量工具，将更多取决于经济和物价数据的变化，而不是提前给出方向性暗示。
segments.tr: - **View 1: The pace of aggregate tools may be more prudent.** Some analyses believe that no longer mentioning this expression may mean whether to use aggregate tools such as lowering reserve requirement ratios and interest rates in the short term will depend more on changes in economic and price data rather than giving directional hints in advance.

segments.src: - **观点二：政策重心可能向结构性工具倾斜。** 也有观点认为，新增“六张网”等重点领域，体现的是“精准发力”的思路，即通过结构性工具引导资金流向重点领域，而不完全依赖总量放松。
segments.tr: - **View 2: The policy focus may tilt toward structural tools.** Some views also believe that adding key areas such as the "six networks" reflects the idea of "precise force", that is, guiding funds to flow to key areas through structural tools, rather than relying entirely on aggregate easing.

segments.src: - **观点三：不宜过度解读。** 还有观点提醒，通稿中少了一句话，并不等于排除相关操作。货币政策会根据国内外形势灵活调整，例会措辞只是政策取向的一个参考，不能简单等同于操作预告。
segments.tr: - **View 3: It is not advisable to over-interpret.** Some views remind that missing a sentence in the press release does not mean excluding related operations. Monetary policy will be flexibly adjusted according to domestic and foreign situations, and the wording of the regular meeting is only a reference for policy orientation and cannot be simply equated with operation previews.

segments.src: 需要指出的是，以上均为市场人士的解读，并非官方结论。
segments.tr: It should be pointed out that the above are all interpretations by market participants, not official conclusions.

segments.src: ## 三、评估四季度政策空间，可以关注哪些因素
segments.tr: ## III. Evaluating the policy space in the fourth quarter, what factors can be paid attention to

segments.src: 判断货币政策的空间，通常需要综合多个方面的信息：
segments.tr: Judging the room for monetary policy usually requires synthesizing information from multiple aspects:

segments.src: 1. **经济运行数据**：包括增长、消费、投资、进出口等指标，是判断“逆周期调节”力度的基础。
segments.tr: 1. **Economic operation data**: Including indicators such as growth, consumption, investment, import and export, which are the basis for judging the intensity of "counter-cyclical adjustment".

segments.src: 2. **物价走势**：CPI、PPI等价格指标的变化，会影响货币政策的权衡。
segments.tr: 2. **Price trend**: Changes in price indicators such as CPI and PPI will affect the trade-offs of monetary policy.

segments.src: 3. **银行体系状况**：商业银行的净息差和资本补充情况，是评估利率调整空间时的重要参考。
segments.tr: 3. **Banking system status**: The net interest margin and capital replenishment of commercial banks are important references when evaluating the room for interest rate adjustment.

segments.src: 4. **汇率与外部环境**：主要经济体的货币政策变化和国际金融市场波动，也会对国内政策产生影响。
segments.tr: 4. **Exchange rate and external environment**: Monetary policy changes of major economies and fluctuations in the international financial market will also have an impact on domestic policies.

segments.src: 5. **财政与货币的配合**：财政政策发力的节奏、重大项目的推进情况，会与货币政策形成配合。
segments.tr: 5. **Fiscal and monetary coordination**: The pace of fiscal policy efforts and the advancement of major projects will form coordination with monetary policy.

segments.src: ## 四、后续值得留意的节点
segments.tr: ## IV. Subsequent nodes worth noting

segments.src: - 央行后续公布的货币信贷、社会融资规模等金融统计数据；
segments.tr: - Financial statistics such as monetary credit and social financing scale subsequently released by the central bank;

segments.src: - 贷款市场报价利率（LPR）以及公开市场操作、结构性工具的运用情况；
segments.tr: - The loan prime rate (LPR) and the application of open market operations and structural tools;

segments.src: - 央行发布的四季度货币政策执行报告和相关表态；
segments.tr: - The fourth-quarter monetary policy implementation report and related statements released by the central bank;

segments.src: - 年底前后召开的重要经济工作会议，对明年宏观政策取向的部署。
segments.tr: - Important economic work conferences held around the end of the year on the deployment of next year's macro policy orientation.

segments.src: ## 小结
segments.tr: ## Summary

segments.src: 这次例会的信息可以概括为：**基调仍是“适度宽松”，调节上更强调“逆周期”并加大力度，支持方向上新增“六张网”，同时不再提及“择机降准降息”。** 这些变化如何转化为具体操作，还要看接下来的经济数据和政策落地情况。对于普通读者而言，与其对单个措辞做过度推演，不如持续关注官方发布的权威信息，理性看待市场上的各种解读。
segments.tr: The information of this regular meeting can be summarized as: **The tone is still "moderately loose", the adjustment emphasizes "counter-cyclical" and increases intensity, the support direction adds "six networks", and at the same time, it no longer mentions "opportunely lowering reserve requirement ratios and interest rates".** How these changes translate into specific operations depends on the subsequent economic data and policy implementation. For ordinary readers, rather than over-deducing a single wording, it is better to continue to pay attention to the authoritative information released by officials and look at various interpretations in the market rationally.
